name: Walls Have Options
jem_summary: Drink one Lava Vision potion and one Clinging potion.

pages.title: Walls Have Options
pages.text: Drink one Lava Vision potion and one Clinging potion.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Brew both using their actual potion recipes. Drink safely before testing lava visibility or ceiling movement; the task checks consumption, not a dangerous route.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Bone Serpent tooth with a lava bottle supports Lava Vision; Dropbear claw supports Clinging for ceilings. These are distinct real potions; beware the ceiling ambush.
